description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Alert' along with several related alert components such as 'ToastAlert' and 'InlineAlert'. The components are used to display alert messages with various types ('info', 'success', 'error', 'warning') and include animations and styling. It leverages 'framer-motion' for animations and Tailwind CSS classes for styling.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: Main React component for displaying customizable alert messages with animations, icons, and optional close button.

methods.name: ToastAlert
methods.description: Component for displaying temporary, dismissible toast notifications positioned on the screen.

methods.name: InlineAlert
methods.description: Component for inline alert messages, typically within content flow, with show/hide animations.
